[SWS_TS_00061]
⌈
If GlobalTimeCorrectionProps.allowProviderRateCorrection equals true,
and the rate deviation (= rateCorrection - 1.0) is within the valid range [-Glob-
alTimeCorrectionProps.MasterRateDeviationMax .. GlobalTimeCorrec-
tionProps.MasterRateDeviationMax] , when ara::tsync::Synchronized-
TimeBaseProvider::SetRateCorrection is called, TS shall set the rate correc-
tion value to the value of parameter rateCorrection.
If
GlobalTimeCorrectionProps.allowProviderRateCorrection
equals
false,
ara::tsync::SynchronizedTimeBaseProvider::SetRateCorrec-
tion TS shall not set a new rate correction value and shall return error code
kFunctionNotSupported.
⌋
